name: @thirdlight/behavior-build
description: Thirdlight M2 behavior build (docs/contracts/project-model.md §22, packet 33): the Node-side, pure behavior source parser/static analyzer, the canonical digest-bound `BehaviorManifest` builder and the shared `compileBehavior` over supplied in-memory bytes. It reads no filesystem path, clock, network endpoint or environment, never imports/executes/evaluates project source, and uses the pinned `esbuild@0.28.2` only as a parser/transformer through an in-memory resolver (dependencies.md §4.1/§4.3: `project-model` types + `parseDocumentBytes`, `esbuild`; no Node built-ins, no runtime/three/editor/backend/workspace/commands/protocol edge, no browser globals).
